title: Washing-machine speed sensor, sensor board from China, housed in Thailand
description: A motor speed sensor: a Hall-effect circuit board made in China, a wire harness and a connector, enclosed in a plastic housing in Thailand. CBP held China (N350727): the sensor board decides.
notes: One of the families added in D138 (PCBA electronic devices). Precedents are limited to rulings dated before 2025-07-09, and N350727 itself is excluded. Picked by family, not by result (D191): the first D171 fixture of each of four families. Recorded result (eval/results/planner-families-n350727-litellm.json): the engine said China at 0.98 stated, where CBP held China (it agrees with CBP). First plan shown: "Move the PCBA (SMT) to Thailand" (in this product: Printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) with Hall Effect sensor; Manufacture PCBA with Hall Effect sensor), check 0.96 on N344809. That ruling, read by hand: supports (N344809 held Thailand for speed sensors once the sensing IC was made in Thailand.) A run on this site is a new run and may differ.

product.name: washing machine motor speed sensor (part number 290D1187P006)
product.description: A washing machine motor speed sensor that creates an electromagnetic field to detect motor speed and send electrical signals to the washing machine control unit. It is comprised of a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) with a Hall Effect sensor enclosed within a plastic housing, and a wire harness with a specialized electrical connector at the end.
